clauses.requirement: Bulk current injection (BCI) immunity testing of the electronic assembly (ESA, e.g. LED PCB of the rear lamp) shall be performed as a method of inducing currents directly into a wiring harness using a current injection probe.

The BCI test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench, either with the substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or with the closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA; alternatively the ESA may be tested installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 using the BCI substitution method with injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.

For ESAs in the configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" (applicable only if the lamp ESA has such a configuration), the test arrangement shall follow the example in Appendix 3 to Annex 9 (Figure 1 for the substitution method and Figure 2 for the closed loop method).

Figure 2 of Appendix 3 gives the example test arrangement for the closed loop method for ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid"; the closed loop BCI test arrangement shall be consistent with this figure.

For ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the shielding configuration shall match the vehicle series configuration; all shielded HV parts (e.g. AN, cables, connectors) shall generally be connected with low impedance to ground; ESAs and loads shall be connected to ground; the external HV power supply shall be connected via feed-through filtering.

For ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", unless otherwise specified, with the substitution method the LV and HV harness length shall be 1,700 mm (+300/-0 mm), spaced 100 mm (+100/-0 mm) apart, and the HV/LV harness shall be straight over at least 1,400 mm starting at the ESA for all ISO 11452-4 test methods except the BCI closed-loop method with power limitation; with the closed loop method the LV and HV harness length shall be 1,000 mm (+200/-0 mm), spaced 100 mm (+100/-0 mm) apart, and the harness shall be straight over its entire length for the BCI closed-loop method with power limitation.

For ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", all harnesses shall be placed on a non-conductive, low relative permittivity material (εr≤1.4) at (50 ± 5) mm above the ground plane.

For ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", shielded supply lines for HV+ and HV- and three-phase lines may be coaxial cables or in a common shield depending on the plug system used; the original HV harness from the vehicle may optionally be used.
